fields.description: Park Lane brings Vida-designed interiors to apartments and townhouses in Dubai Hills Estate. The collection includes one to three bedroom apartments and four three-bedroom townhouses, with a landscaped podium for swimming, exercise and gatherings. Its building and podium layouts offer markedly different balcony sizes, so the specific plan matters as much as the bedroom count.

overview: The brochure describes warm, earthy interiors in Vida’s design style. Shared spaces centre on the podium and a flexible indoor room intended for exercise, gatherings and children’s activities. Its apartment and townhouse collection looks towards landscaped outdoor areas and the wider neighbourhood. The interior-design association alone does not establish hotel management, furnished delivery or included hospitality services.
research.locationNote: Emaar places Park Lane in Dubai Hills Estate, with road access towards Al Khail Road and nearby park and mall destinations. The fact sheet advertises park access; check the exact entrance from the chosen building. Planned rail and metro references are not confirmation of current local services.
research.priceNote: The developer advertises AED 1.4m. March 2024 launch starts are AED 1.4m for one-bedroom apartments, AED 2.18m for two, AED 3.31m for three and AED 5.58m for townhouses. These historical prices require a current unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The launch document shows 10% on booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% on completion. Bayut reports the same 10/70/20 split. Obtain the outstanding schedule for a new allocation or resale.
research.handoverNote: October 2028 is the launch document’s estimated completion month; Bayut corroborates Q4 2028. Confirm the current building-specific programme and contract.

facts.label: Published collection
facts.value: The fact sheet lists 850 apartments and four townhouses, or 854 homes in total. This is not an available-stock count.

facts.label: Townhouse layout
facts.value: The podium townhouses are duplex homes. Living, dining, kitchen and a maid’s room are on the lower level; all three bedrooms are upstairs. Their suite areas are about 2,283–2,295 sq ft, with balconies accounting for the rest of the published total.

facts.label: Building 1A example
facts.value: One-bedroom unit 2106 is 606.98 sq ft including a 56.73 sq ft balcony. First-floor unit 106 is 968.54 sq ft with a 385.24 sq ft balcony. These are distinct layouts, not interchangeable size descriptions.

facts.label: Building 1B example
facts.value: Two-bedroom unit 2105 totals 922.90 sq ft. Unit 2007 totals 1,717.81 sq ft, including a 794.27 sq ft balcony. Its much larger advertised area is largely outdoor space.

facts.label: Building 3B example
facts.value: One-bedroom unit 101 totals 1,088.88 sq ft, with 503.21 sq ft of balcony. Typical one-bedroom plans in this block are approximately 647–652 sq ft. Building-specific drawings are linked in Sources.
